description.mn: Acqua di Parma Note di Colonia III: Unisex хув үнэр (Cologne). Эхний ноот: мандарин, цагаан гаа; зүрхний ноот: хүж, ветивер, жасмин; суурь ноот: мирра, лабданум, тонка шош.
description.en: Note di Colonia III by Acqua di Parma is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Note di Colonia III was launched in 2016. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Ginger; middle notes are Olibanum, Vetiver and Jasmine; base notes are Myrhh, Labdanum and Tonka Bean.
